observation.visible_scene: A nighttime outdoor scene featuring a rocky cliff face illuminated with cool blue and white lights. Several bright yellow, illuminated deer figures are positioned at various heights on the cliff, including standing and grazing poses. A calm body of water in the foreground reflects these lights and figures.
visible_changes: The camera pans slowly and steadily to the left throughout the clip.
As the camera pans left, the deer figure on the far right edge of the frame gradually moves out of view.
Conversely, a deer figure with antlers on the far left ledge, initially partially cut off or out of frame, becomes fully visible.
A new, partially visible deer figure enters the frame on the extreme left edge towards the end of the clip.
The reflections in the water shift horizontally in sync with the camera movement, mirroring the changing view of the cliff.
outside_clip_unknowns: The full extent of the light display beyond the left and right boundaries of the panning shot.
Whether the deer are physical sculptures or projected light installations.
uncertain_details: The slight ripples in the water reflections suggest minor water movement, but the primary motion is the camera pan.
